definitions.r0: number of variables in the legitimate original root before any propagation
definitions.s0: N-r0, an upper bound on the first ordinary-state size after zero or more unit-propagation steps

transition_lemma.statement: At any frozen ordinary-elimination stage whose unit-free canonical residual has state_units<=s, if T(s)<=N^2 then every live pivot is raw-cap safe. The exact canonical residual after the deterministic ordinary elimination, followed by any subsequent unit propagation/restriction, has state_units<=T(s) and at least one fewer live variable.
proof: Mixed pivots satisfy RAW<=1+(state_units-1)^2/12<=1+(s-1)^2/12<=T(s) by monotonicity for s>=1.
If T(s)<=N^2, eliminate_var_capped cannot raw-abort on any live pivot; therefore first_capped_elimination selects its deterministic first live pivot.
Canonicalization cannot enlarge beyond the charged raw accumulator, and exact unit propagation/restriction after the step cannot enlarge the residual.
Ordinary existential elimination removes its pivot and introduces no fresh semantic variable, so live-variable count decreases by at least one.

small_N_closed_form.proof: For every nonterminal root with r0>=2, s0<=N-2<=13. On 1<=s<=13, 1+(s-1)^2/12<=s, hence T(s)=s. The envelope is nonincreasing through every ordinary elimination, so raw-cap rescue cannot be needed.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N19
theorem.statement: For every legitimate root with frozen input size N<=19, whenever the current solver reaches an ordinary-elimination stage instead of terminating in an earlier exact lane, ordinary exact elimination remains raw-cap available for enough successive variable-removal steps to exhaust the original live-variable budget. Therefore v2/v3 extension rescue cannot be required because of NO_CAPPED_CERTIFIED_MOVE/raw-cap unavailability on these size layers.

example_parameter_case.note: The sufficient recurrence eventually permits an envelope approximately 427.326, exceeding cap 400.

first_unresolved_size_by_this_method.interpretation: This is only failure of the sufficient envelope certificate. It does NOT prove any legitimate N=20 root actually needs extension or reaches OPEN.

relationship_to_exhaustive_census.N12_N17: The previously completed exhaustive frozen-v3 census through N=17 observed OPEN=0 and extension_count=0 on 444946 normalized legitimate roots. The new theorem independently explains the absence of raw-cap rescue on these layers and extends the cap-availability guarantee through N=19 without enumerating N18 or N19 roots.
relationship_to_exhaustive_census.finite_census_remains_useful_for: implementation replay, terminal-lane behavior and witness reconstruction; it is not needed for the new cap-availability theorem.

next_exact_target: Analyze legitimate N=20 roots or derive a sharper reachable-state envelope using remaining-variable combinatorics, while the current-v3 N^2 selector-tower scout searches for a larger-N extension witness.
